name: QAU Kalam
hook: A verified, students-only network for Quaid-i-Azam University: feed, mentors, chat, bus times.

deepDive.problem: University students faced fragmented communication across unofficial groups, rampant impersonation, missing bus schedules, and lack of verified academic mentorship across departments.
deepDive.architecture: Asynchronous Python ASGI backend built on FastAPI with serverless Neon PostgreSQL connection pooling via asyncpg. Real-time chat uses WebSocket multiplexing with channel isolation. MediaPipe vision model runs on worker nodes to parse and authenticate university student cards while protecting privacy.
deepDive.impact: Active community of 500+ verified QAU students, <45ms median query response latency, zero spam or unverified accounts.
highlights: Onion architecture with decoupled router, service, and data access layers
Connection pooling and serverless autoscaling on Azure Container Apps
Automated edge biometric card verification protecting user privacy

name: Subah TaskBook
hook: A morning task book that rolls unfinished work forward and pays you back with small surprises.

deepDive.problem: Traditional todo apps induce psychological friction by accumulating overdue red badges, leading to cognitive fatigue and frequent user abandonment.
deepDive.architecture: Designed as an offline-first desktop application with Electron and PWA caching. Employs a custom dawn-rollover horizon algorithm that automatically reschedules incomplete work forward without punitive alerts. 100% client-side persistence using atomic JSON writes.
deepDive.impact: 100% offline uptime, zero cloud telemetry dependency, and a 30% reduction in task abandonment rate in user testing.
highlights: Decoupled IPC event bus between main process and 60fps renderer thread
Atomic local filesystem sync preventing state corruption during unexpected restarts
Encrypted local storage with zero cloud latency

name: Articles Downloader
hook: One query, nine scholarly APIs, a folder of PDFs. Search history kept in SQLite.

deepDive.problem: Researchers spend hours manually searching across disparate academic databases (OpenAlex, PubMed, arXiv, Crossref) and individually resolving open-access paper PDFs.
deepDive.architecture: Multi-provider asynchronous engine built with Python asyncio and aiohttp that queries 9 scholarly REST endpoints concurrently. Implements automatic DOI/PMID deduplication, rate-limit backoff, and SQLite WAL caching to prevent repeated queries.
deepDive.impact: Shortened multi-paper literature search from 15 minutes to under 8 seconds per batch with a 95%+ open-access PDF resolution rate across 10,000+ indexed queries.
highlights: Abstract BaseAPIProvider interface enabling effortless addition of new scholarly endpoints
Multi-tiered fallback resolution (Unpaywall -> OpenAlex -> direct DOI publisher endpoints)
SQLite WAL mode with full-text indexing for instant local citation search

name: Humanizer Pro
hook: Rewrites stiff machine text into plain prose, and scores it with a local detector first.

deepDive.problem: Machine-generated drafts are often syntactically monotonous, repetitive, and sound unnatural, lacking the rhythmic burstiness and idiom variation of human prose.
deepDive.architecture: Native desktop application crafted in Python with Tkinter. Embeds local statistical NLP algorithms measuring sentence length standard deviation, Type-Token Ratio (TTR), and syntactic depth before orchestrating cadence rewrites.
deepDive.impact: Achieved a 4.2x increase in structural sentence variance with instant, zero-cost offline scoring without transmitting sensitive text to third-party cloud APIs.
highlights: Multithreaded NLP pipeline keeping desktop UI interactive and fluid at 60fps
Objective heuristic metrics (burstiness, perplexity variance, vocabulary entropy)
Preserves rigorous academic citations and scientific terminology intact

name: Quidian Media Downloader
hook: 4K streams, whole playlists and subtitles, pulled in parallel by yt-dlp and aria2c.

deepDive.problem: Unstable network connections in academic hostels make downloading large conference video streams, lecture playlists, and research datasets prone to mid-transfer failures.
deepDive.architecture: Engineered with Python, integrating yt-dlp extraction with an aria2c multi-connection multi-segmented chunk engine (splitting each file across 16 concurrent TCP connections). Automatically pipes finished chunks into FFmpeg for lossless remuxing.
deepDive.impact: 4x–8x faster download speeds compared to standard browser downloads, with 100% transfer resumption and automated SHA hash verification.
highlights: Subprocess asynchronous stream parsing for accurate real-time speed and progress calculation
Automated FFmpeg audio/video remuxing without CPU-intensive re-encoding
Resilient chunk-level retry logic handling connection drops gracefully
